title: Żawʾ al-Lamaʿāt
transliterated_title: Żawʾ al-Lamaʿāt (Commentary on ʿIrāqī's Lamaʿāt; variant Sharḥ-i Lamaʿāt)
genre: commentary on ʿIrāqī's Lamaʿāt in 28 gleams

date.basis: Melvin-Koushki says it was written over the course of 815/1412, presumably in Isfahan; the entry cites no colophon for this and prints no asterisk. The Majlis copy is dated 8 Dhū l-Qaʿda 828/21 September 1425.

manuscript: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 148b-53b (copied 828/1425); MS Ankara 15/4 pp. 59-72 (833/1429); MS 5423 ff. 124b-38a (842/1439); 16 copies listed.
summary: A commentary on ʿIrāqī's Lamaʿāt in 28 gleams, drawing on Ibn ʿArabī, Qūnavī and Aḥmad Ghazālī on love, the Breath of the Merciful, the Muḥammadan reality, receptivity and effusion.
